voice.heroLede: Omya provides innovative raw materials to the personal care industry.
voice.firstParagraph: As a distributor of high-quality, innovative ingredients from around the globe, we strive to exceed the development needs of our customers while remaining conscious of the impact on the environment.
voice.tone: B2B, consultative, ingredient-supplier; first-person plural ("we strive to exceed…"), benefit + sustainability claims

Data Protection / Sales Terms / Impressum / Terms of Use / Privacy Policy / Consent Choices on 71/71; bg-body.gif blueprint texture on 71/71

h2 "Insights" + latest blog card + "Read Our Blog" on 20/71

narrative.overview: A WordPress/Bootstrap-3 B2B site in Omya blue and white: photo heroes with a dark overlay and centred white titles, parallelogram buttons, square corners, Arial throughout.
keyCharacteristics: Omya blue #007ac1 carries headings, bands and primary buttons
Square corners; only the FIND A REP fab is round
Arial for everything; no web text font renders
Every interior page ends with a blue Contact Omya form band

rules.name: The Parallelogram Rule
rules.body: Buttons are skewX(-10deg) boxes with the label counter-skewed upright.

dos: Do keep heading blue on white and white on photo heroes.
donts: Don't round button or card corners.
